name: Dirty Fantasies: Maid for Mischief
source:
With the onset of summer vacation, Jennifer decides to find herself a job and soon embarks on a fresh chapter of her life as a maid in the luxurious household of Mr. and Mrs. Clark. A good salary, convenient hours, and pleasant employers - what more could she desire? 

Yet, one day, she accidentally stumbles upon a clandestine aspect of her employers' lives, and soon, consumed by curiosity, she finds herself drawn into their world...

[From [url=https://fallen-pie.itch.io/dirty-fantasies-maid-for-mischief]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
随着暑假的到来，詹妮弗决定给自己找一份工作，并很快在克拉克夫妇的豪华家庭中担任女佣，开启了她人生的新篇章。丰厚的薪水、便利的工作时间、令人愉快的雇主——她还能奢求什么呢？

然而，有一天，她无意中发现了雇主生活中的秘密，很快，在好奇心的驱使下，她发现自己被吸引到了他们的世界……

[来自[url=https://fallen-pie.itch.io/dirty-fantasies-maid-for-mischief]Itch.io[/url]]
